# Barbulianno Design

> A UK-based sustainable interior design platform curating biophilic, eco-friendly home decor through expert styling, ethical maker directories, and green living guidance.

Founded by Vanja Barbul, Barbulianno Design combines interior styling expertise with a mission to promote sustainable, locally-made home furnishings and conscious consumption. The platform serves as both an educational resource and marketplace for eco-conscious homeowners and artisan makers across the UK.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Home Decor
- Biophilic Interior Design
- Eco-Friendly Homeware

## Core Platform

- [Barbulianno Design](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com): Barbulianno homepage showcasing sustainable, biophilic interior design and eco-friendly home decor
- [About](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/sustainable-design-uk-about): About Barbulianno Design and founder Vanja Barbul's mission for sustainable eco-friendly interiors

## Design Resources & Guides

- [Sustainable Home Guide](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/sustainable-home-decorating-guide): Comprehensive guide to sustainable home decorating using natural materials and green living practices
- [Blog](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/interior-design-services-uk-blog): Interior design blog featuring sustainable home decorating ideas and eco-friendly furnishing inspiration
- [Mood Boards](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/mood-boards): Mood boards with shopping lists and budgets for eco-friendly interior styling and home decoration

## Makers & Shopping

- [Makers](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/shop-locally-handmade-home-decor): Directory of UK artisan makers and local sustainable furniture brands supporting conscious consumption
- [Eco Shop](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/eco-friendly-home-decor-shop): Eco-friendly homeware shop featuring ethical, organic and sustainable brands for green living

## Community & Collaboration

- [Get Featured](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/get-featured): Application page for UK homeware makers to join Barbulianno's Green Makers Community
- [Contact](https://www.barbuliannodesign.com/eco-friendly-home-decor-contact): Contact page for styling advice, collaborations and maker submissions to Manchester-based Barbulianno
